apis: ContextInternal::createSet(const Address &,const Address &) (globalcontext.cc:470-475; partmap split/clearRange partmap.hh:117/144)
analysis_options.document_selection: The complete locked x86-64.pspec is ingested on the C++ side through the real BfdArchitecture::init chain (which also decodes the production <context_set> low-level blob via SLEIGH-registered variables); observations select the tracked-set state. The Rust side reads the same locked pspec bytes with a fixture-local Element DOM and drives Architecture::decode_context_data (production pspec text ingestion into a full processor-spec parse remains ARCH-0001 residual).
analysis_options.register_resolution: C++ resolves <set name='DF'> through SleighBase::getRegister on the live translator; the Rust fixture resolves through the same locked .sla via the SLEIGH FFI catalog (Translate::getAllRegisters), pinned to a single register space.
analysis_options.setup_model: The C++ 'production' group is the real init chain (init -> parseProcessorConfig -> decodeFromSpec). The Rust 'production' group is Architecture::new + decode_context_data on the locked pspec <context_data> element; the byte diff pins both to the same tracked partitions (probes through ContextDatabase::getTrackedSet vs Architecture::get_tracked_set).
analysis_options.normalization: No ids, orders, values, or exception texts are normalized. Partition coverage is observed through getTrackedSet probes because trackbase is protected; the empty default is observed through getTrackedDefault().size().

cases.production: Full BfdArchitecture::init chain on the locked spec set and curl binary (spec-dir scan -> init -> restoreFromSpec -> parseProcessorConfig ELEM_CONTEXT_DATA -> ContextInternal::decodeFromSpec, globalcontext.cc:531); observed: <context_set> child count from the processor_spec DOM, getTrackedDefault().size(), and getTrackedSet probes across ram (0x0 / 0x403000 / highest) — the x86-64.pspec <tracked_set space='ram'><set name='DF' val='0'/> shape resolving to register:20a:1.
cases.c1_minimal_whole_space: Synthetic minimal <tracked_set space='ram'> with one <set name='DF' val='0'/>: probes at ram 0x0 / 0x403000 / highest all see DF; range with no first/last spans the whole space with the next-space open boundary (Range::decodeFromAttributes + getLastAddrOpen, address.cc:316/265).
cases.c2_explicit_range_two_sets: <tracked_set space='ram' first='0x100' last='0x1ff'> with DF then EAX <set> children: probe 0xff (below -> default empty), 0x100 / 0x1ff (both entries in document order), 0x200 (above -> the empty tail split installed at last+1).
cases.c3_later_set_overrides: Two tracked_sets [0x100,0x2ff] DF=0 then [0x200,0x2ff] DF=1: 0x1ff keeps the first set, 0x200/0x2ff see the override, 0x300 falls to the empty tail — the partmap split-copy + clearRange-erase semantics (partmap.hh:117/144).
cases.c4_register_name_range: <tracked_set name='DF'> range form: the register extent becomes the range (address.cc:334-341); probes register:0x209 (empty), register:0x20a (set), register:0x20b (empty tail).
cases.c5_explicit_varnode_and_max_val: <set space='register' offset='0x20a' size='1' val='0x123'/> explicit storage form (VarnodeData::decodeFromAttributes space branch with rewind + AddrSpace::decodeAttributes) plus <set name='RAX' val='0xffffffffffffffff'/> (max uintb through cpp-stream hex parsing).
cases.errors: Seven verbatim oracle texts: e1 <tracked_set> without space -> 'No address space indicated in range tag'; e2 <bogus/> child -> same range error first (Range::decodeFromAttributes runs before the child-name dispatch); e2b <bogus space='ram'/> -> 'Bad <context_data> tag' (only reachable when the range decodes); e3 first>last -> 'Illegal range tag'; e4 unknown register -> 'Unknown register name: NOSUCHREG'; e5 unknown space -> 'Unknown address space name: nosuchspace'; e6 <register val='0'/> inside tracked_set -> 'Expecting <set> but got <register>' (probe name chosen inside the locked ElementId table; TreeDecoder maps table-external names to XMLunknown — registered residual).

observation_schema.format: One compact UTF-8 JSON object with fixed key and array order plus final newline.
observation_schema.probes: getTrackedSet(get_tracked_set) at fixed addresses: count plus per-entry {space name, offset hex, size, val decimal}.
observation_schema.default_count: getTrackedDefault().size() — decodeFromSpec never assigns the partition-map default, so it stays empty.
observation_schema.errors: Verbatim LowlevelError/DecoderError explain strings from seven malformed documents.

coverage.production_pspec_tracked_state: MATCH: the real init chain's tracked partitions (DF register:20a:1 val=0 across the whole ram space incl. the highest offset, which pins the next-space open boundary of getLastAddrOpen), context_set child accounting, and the empty default.
coverage.whole_space_and_explicit_ranges: MATCH: no-first/last spans the space; explicit first/last installs the empty tail split at last+1 (probe above the range returns count 0).
coverage.document_order_of_set_children: MATCH: c2 lists DF then EAX in decode order (EAX register:0x0 size 4 val 1).
coverage.later_set_override_semantics: MATCH: partmap split-copy + clearRange erase — later tracked_set overrides only within its range, the earlier set survives below, the tail split stays empty.
coverage.register_name_range_form: MATCH: <tracked_set name='DF'> builds the range from the register extent; below/in/above probes agree.
coverage.explicit_varnode_storage_and_max_val: MATCH: space/offset/size attribute form (rewind + decodeAttributes, missing-offset error path compiled in) and 0xffffffffffffffff through hex stream parsing.
coverage.oracle_error_texts: MATCH: all seven texts verbatim, including the e2/e2b pair proving Range::decodeFromAttributes runs before the child-name dispatch and 'Bad <context_data> tag' is only reachable with a decodable range.
coverage.context_set_low_level_blob: MISMATCH (scoped out): the production <context_set> decode requires the .sla context layout registered in the Rust ContextDatabase (SLEIGHBase::reregisterContext -> sleigh context sharing, sleigh_arch.cc:181); Rust consumes and counts the child (SLEIGH-0002C residual). The shared projection observes only the child count.
coverage.cross_space_partition_interleave: UNTESTED: Ghidra orders Address by live baselist index, Rugra by AddressSpace::space_id; same-space lookups (the production consumer shape) are covered, cross-space splits/probes are not.
coverage.table_external_element_names: MISMATCH (scoped out): TreeDecoder maps element names outside the locked ElementId table to XMLunknown, so the e6 probe uses the in-table <register> name; raw DOM-name surfacing is a MARSHAL-domain gap (same class as the ATTRIB_CONTENT gap in CSPEC-TEXT-INGEST-0001).
coverage.missing_val_attribute: UNTESTED: a <set> without val indexes out of bounds in the oracle (marshal.cc:371-372, getAttributeValue(-1)); the Rust mirror returns 0 instead of undefined behavior and the path is not probed.
coverage.production_processor_spec_text_ingestion: MISMATCH: the Rust fixture builds the Element DOM locally; a full processor-spec parse pipeline (parseProcessorConfig dispatch over every pspec child) is ARCH-0001's residual. The worker-side call site for decode_context_data ships with the ActionConstbase wiring handover (coreaction lease).
